versions.changelog: Links to ytapi.dev pages carry utm_source=skill.

- Initial release of ytapi skill (v1.0.0)
- Supports YouTube transcripts, video details, search, channels, and playlists via the YTAPI REST API
- Handles HTTP 429 and access issues common on servers/cloud agents by using YTAPI as a backend
- Requires YTAPI_API_KEY, with steps to generate a free API key if not provided
- Includes credit-based pricing, batch processing, and error handling guidance
